candidates.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS
candidates.summary: Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic's most capable Opus model for agentic coding, knowledge work, and long-running tasks, is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. This post covers what's new in Opus 5.5, practical guidance, and how to start building with the model on Amazon Bedrock.

candidates.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
candidates.summary: OpenAI is launching two new models, which it says are cut from the same cloth as Astra.

candidates.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
candidates.summary: Using GPT-5.6, Ringg powers multilingual agents across voice, chat, WhatsApp, and web for 90% less cost vs. GPT-4.1.

candidates.title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
candidates.summary: Learn how Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models to help engineering teams solve bugs, design systems, and ship faster.

candidates.title: Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI
candidates.summary: Qualcomm said that its new top chip can run 30B mixture-of-expert model locally.

candidates.title: Evaluate skill-equipped agents with Strands Evals and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Skills let you encode domain-specific procedures as reusable, portable instructions for agents, but a fluent answer doesn't prove the agent picked the right skill or followed it. Learn how to measure skill selection and instruction following with Strands Evals and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations.
